problems: In the town the crossing's deck ends in mid-air above the banks: there are no landings, ramps or steps down to the bank path (the bank ground is at about y 0 just beyond |z| 7).
elements.fix: Add a clear landing at each end: ramps, steps or an abutment that brings the deck down to bank level at z = ±7 and a little beyond (to |z| 7.6). The water itself is drawn by the town under the piece: no water slabs of your own. Keep everything within |x| ≤ 7.

problems: In the town the camp stands on the river's east bank with the river running just beyond its +z edge, but the barges float in a separate rectangular pond of its own, away from the river.
elements.fix: Drop the pond and any water slab. Moor the barges against the +z edge (half over it, as if on the river) with a short jetty or mooring posts; keep the tents and goods on dry ground behind them.
